Definition
[Aleksandrov space] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0424, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0425 1. appG:G.35–G.36\group Comparison geometry A geodesic triangle in a complete length space consists of three points and shortest paths joining them; a hinge is two such paths with a common vertex. A complete locally compact length space has curvature $\geq k$ if every point has a neighborhood on which comparison triangles satisfy the opposite-side inequality. The same inequality for every triangle defines curvature $\geq k$ in the large.
